elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3× annual fees
elements.evidence: No super-cap figure is inserted; 21.3 treats indemnification as an Excluded Claim without a 3× cap.

reasons: All atomic preferred elements are present: defend and indemnify, Customer plus Affiliates, all four coverage triggers (IP infringement of Services/Deliverables, Vendor breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incident, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), notice/control/cooperation procedure only, and a Customer indemnity confined to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

The fallback bargain is incomplete (no Customer-modification/combination/specification exclusions and no 3× annual-fees super-cap), but the locked target is preferred, which is satisfied on its own terms.

The infringement remedy paragraph (procure/modify/replace/refund) overlaps the fallback remedy set, yet it is justified as minimal because existing Section 9.3 expressly cross-references "the remedies required by Section 20.5"; without it the document would carry a dangling cross-reference.
No extraneous additions: no hold-harmless doubling, no extra indemnitees, no Customer defence duty, and no settlement-consent mechanics beyond notice, control and cooperation.

Untouched terms (9.3 termination right, 19.5 warranty disclaimer, 21.3 Excluded Claims) remain effective, and all inserted defined terms (Affiliates, Applicable Law, Customer Data, Deliverables, Fees) are already defined.
